en: Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses
zh: 变更 mod 的 `settings.read` hook：改为接收每个设置层并重写合并后的设置，使受管理的 mod 能将组织设置设为上限，包括保留清理所用的 `cleanupPeriodDays`
